description: Balanced moderate heat-conduction FOM dataset for Transolver training.
storage_format: one compressed NPZ file per sample plus this manifest

arrays.coordinates: (n_nodes, 2) duplicate of pos for explicit FEM naming
arrays.nodal_material_id: (n_nodes,) rounded node material tag for quick checks
arrays.edge_index: (2, n_edges) directed triangle-edge graph, optional for graph loaders

transolver_note: This dataset preserves variable triangular meshes per sample. Current Transolver integration intentionally uses batch_size=1.
